₹5,000 ka monthly SIP, ₹50 lakh ban sakta hai. Toh phir aapka SIP itna bekaar kyun lagta hai?
Maan lo, aap har mahine ₹5,000 invest karte ho.
5 saal baad: ₹3 lakh daale, value hai kareeb ₹4 lakh. Kaafi slow lagta hai na?
10 saal baad: ₹6 lakh daale, value kareeb ₹11.5 lakh.
20 saal baad: ₹12 lakh daale, value kareeb ₹50 lakh.
Same SIP, same amount. Bas growth late dikhti hai.
Yahi hai compounding. Aapke returns pe bhi returns aane lagte hain.
Aur zyaadatar log teesre saal mein hi SIP band kar dete hain, theek tab, jab curve upar jaane waala hota hai.
Yeh 12% per year maan kar hai. Real returns upar neeche hote rehte hain, koi guarantee nahi hai.
Toh apne SIP ko first year se judge mat karo. 15th year se judge karo.
